description: Universal Claude Code workflow plugin with agents, skills, hooks, and commands

summary.one_liner: A Claude Code workflow plugin bundling specialized agents, slash commands, skills, and hooks for general software projects, installable via skills.sh, npx, or the Claude plugin marketplace.
summary.what_it_does: Provides 7 subagents (orchestrator, code-reviewer, debugger, docs-writer, security-auditor, refactorer, test-architect) that Claude spawns based on the task. Includes 26 slash commands covering output-style modes (architect, rapid, mentor, review), git workflow (commit, commit-push-pr, sync-branch), verification (verify-changes, run-tests, lint-check, security-scan), parallel subagent review/analysis, planning with a persistent PLAN.md, and onboarding. Ships 14 skills, such as designing-architecture, database-design, security-patterns, and devops-infrastructure, loaded on demand. Hooks run on edit, bash, session start, prompt, task completion, and input-needed events; they cover secret scanning, file protection, auto-formatting, TypeScript checks, branch protection, command logging, and desktop notifications. The npx installer copies files into .claude/ and registers hooks in settings.json.
use_cases: automated git commits and pull requests with conventional messages
multi-agent code review and verification before shipping
debugging errors, crashes, and race conditions with a dedicated agent
guarded edits that block secrets and protected files
stack: Markdown agent, command, and skill definitions
notable: Works across 35+ AI coding agents through skills.sh, though only the full plugin install brings agents, commands, and hooks
Hooks automatically block edits containing potential secrets and protect .env and lock files
Multi-subagent verify-changes command runs build, test, lint, and security checks in parallel
Extensible: add commands, agents, or skills by dropping markdown files into the matching folder
caveats: The README warns that the suggested permissions template pre-allows interpreters, network tools (curl, wget), and git push, which permit arbitrary code execution and data egress without a prompt
Requires Claude Code v1.0.33 or later and Python 3 for hook scripts
skills.sh installs skills only; agents, commands, and hooks need the npx installer or plugin install
keywords: help my ai assistant review code
